description_ar: حكمة أو اقتباس بخط ديواني/نسخ، علامة اقتباس كبيرة، ظهور كلمة بكلمة، وتوقيع القائل.
description_en: A quote or wisdom in classical Arabic type: large quote mark, word-by-word reveal and the author's signature.
scene_blueprint_en: Large quote mark (❝) fades/zooms in with a soft glow.
The quote reveals word by word with generous line height (1.6-1.8).
A short divider line draws in, then the author's name fades in beneath.
rules_en: Quote text in Amiri weight 700 with lineHeight 1.7; maximum 20 words.
One quote per scene; hold the finished text for at least 2 s.
Keep the palette to one hue plus gold.
